summary: Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq delisting determination letter on April 28, 2026, for failure to maintain a $1.00 minimum bid price (Rule 5550(a)(2)) and insufficient market value of listed securities. The company has until May 5, 2026 to request a hearing to stay suspension; it intends to do so. Previously, an ADS ratio change and a 1-for-30 reverse share split were implemented to regain compliance. Unspecified terms; no price. Watch the hearing outcome and potential further reverse split or plan to avoid delisting.
